description: This file defines React components and constants related to channel notification settings in the Mattermost web application, including notification levels, UI input data for desktop and mobile notifications, and related configuration objects.

methods.name: desktopNotificationInputFieldData
methods.description: Generates radio button options for desktop notification levels, with optional default message.

methods.name: mobileNotificationInputFieldData
methods.description: Generates radio button options for mobile notification levels, with optional default message.
